title: 1stDibs to Participate in Upcoming Investor Conferences
summary: 1stdibs.com, Inc. (Nasdaq: DIBS), a leading online marketplace for luxury design, today announced participation at the following investor conferences. 1stDibs executives will participate at Planet MicroCap Las Vegas 2026 Conference in Las Vegas on June 17, 2026. There will be a webcast presentation at 11:30am ET, which investors can listen to on our investor relations website at investors.1stdibs.com . Company executives will also participate in non-webcasted investor meetings at the following events: Needham 21st Annual Technology, Media, Consumer Conference on May 14, 2026; William Blair 46th Annual Growth Stock Conference in Chicago on June 2, 2026; Northland Growth Conference 2026 on June 23, 2026. About 1stDibs 1stDibs is a leading online marketplace for connecting design lovers with highly coveted sellers and makers of vintage, antique, and contemporary furniture, home décor, art, jewelry, watches and fashion. Investor Relations: Kevin LaBuz, Head of Investor
